hub.title: Welcome to Symbola
hub.body: This dashboard is your starting point: find your profile, your settings, and administration if you have the rights for it.

hub.title: Complete your company profile
hub.body: To use every feature (quotes, invoicing), first complete your company profile and VAT regime under "Settings".

hub.title: Help is always nearby
hub.body: Every screen has a "?" button that opens a short article on what you can do there. You can also relaunch this tour from that button.

events.title: Your events
events.body: This list gathers your leads and upcoming weddings; the “Past” tab keeps completed or lost events. Filter by name, year, status or source.

events.title: Creating a lead
events.body: “New lead” only needs a first name and the contact source; the date and venue can be added later.

events.title: An event's page
events.body: On the event page, follow the status, vendor slots, planning timeline and wedding day schedule, then invite the couple to follow their preparations.

events.title: Your templates
events.body: Set up your sources, loss reasons and default vendor slots, and prepare your planning timeline and schedule templates: start from the starter templates and adapt them.

events.title: Try without risk
events.body: The guided trial opens a complete fictional wedding to test everything; it is deleted when the trial ends. Relaunch this tour at any time with the “?” button.

login.title: Log in
login.body: Sign in with your email and password. After several failed attempts, the account is temporarily locked to protect it.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.body: The first time, scan the code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy…). After that, just enter the 6-digit code each time you log in.

home.title: Dashboard
home.body: This is your home page. From here you reach your profile, your settings, and administration if you have the rights for it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Fill in your organization's company profile here (SIREN, address, legal form, business) and its VAT regime.

admin.title: Administration
admin.body: Create organizations, invite their owner, and enable or disable their modules. This page shows none of the organizations' business data.

adminSettings.title: Platform settings
adminSettings.body: These VAT exemption thresholds apply to every organization and must be kept up to date with current regulation.

adminHealth.title: Health
adminHealth.body: This page shows whether the application is responding and its deployed version, for a quick status check.

invitation.title: Create my account
invitation.body: This invitation link is personal and single-use. Choose a password to activate your account.

profile.title: My profile
profile.body: Choose the language Symbola displays for you.

eventsList.title: Event list
eventsList.body: Find your prospects and upcoming weddings here, and past ones in the “Finished” tab. Filter by name, year or status, then open an event to see its details. The guided tour can be relaunched with the “?” button, and the guided trial opens a fictional wedding to test everything.

eventsNew.title: New prospect
eventsNew.body: Enter at least one partner's first name and the prospect source (how they found you). The date and venue can be filled in later.

eventsDetail.title: Event details
eventsDetail.body: Track the event's progress here (prospect, quote sent, confirmed, done or lost) and its vendor slots: the top bar counts booked slots out of required ones. A booked slot needs the vendor's name; the amount is optional. The planning timeline lists tasks by month: apply a template, add, check or reorder tasks. If the event date changes, the app offers to shift the due dates of unfinished tasks. The wedding day schedule lists lines by time; the app flags, without blocking, a participant scheduled on two overlapping lines. Export it as a PDF: couple version (without internal notes) or vendors version. Invite the couple to follow their event from the “Couple access” section; when they check a task, it shows in the activity feed.

eventsSettings.title: Event settings
eventsSettings.body: Define your prospect sources (wedding fair, Instagram, word of mouth…), your loss reasons, and the vendor slots every new event receives. The starter template offers a list of common slots that you then adapt.

eventsTemplates.title: Planning timeline templates
eventsTemplates.body: Create your planning timeline templates, or load the starter template and adapt it. Each task is placed relative to the event date: 365 days before, 30 days before, event day… Apply a template from the page of an event with a date.

eventsProgramTemplates.title: Schedule templates
eventsProgramTemplates.body: Prepare your typical wedding day schedules, or load the starter template and adapt it. Apply a template from an event's page: its lines are added to the schedule, and participants named like one of the event's vendor slots are linked to it.

clientInvitation.title: Creating your account
clientInvitation.body: This account is personal: each member of the couple has their own. The invitation link is valid for 7 days; if it has expired, ask your planner for a new one.

clientSpace.title: Your space
clientSpace.body: Find here the weddings your planner shares with you. Open one to follow the planning timeline, check your tasks and see the wedding day schedule.

clientEvent.title: Following the preparations
clientEvent.body: Tasks “For you to do” are checked once done: your planner sees it right away. The others are handled by your planner. The wedding day schedule can be downloaded as a PDF.

clientSecurity.title: Two-factor authentication
clientSecurity.body: Optional for your account. Once enabled, a code from your authenticator app is asked at every login.

Events.title: Events
Events.moduleUnavailable: The Events module is not enabled for your organization.
Events.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again and retry.
Events.noSourcesYet: No source is defined yet. Add one in “Sources and loss reasons”.
Events.missingFirstName: The first partner's first name is required.
Events.suggestMarkDone: This event's date has passed: you can mark it as Done.
Events.reasonFreeText: Ask for details when this reason is chosen (for example “Other”)
Events.vendorProgress: {booked, plural, =0 {No slot booked} one {# slot booked} other {# slots booked}} out of {required}
Events.noVendorSlots: No slot for this event. Add one, or define a default list in the settings.
Events.missingVendorName: Enter the vendor's name for a booked slot.
Events.defaultVendorSlotsIntro: Every new event receives these slots; you then adjust them event by event.
Events.starterVendorSlotsLoaded: {count, plural, =0 {The starter template is already loaded.} one {# slot added from the starter template.} other {# slots added from the starter template.}}
Events.taskTemplatesIntro: Each task in a template has a title, an offset in days from the event date (-365 for 365 days before, 0 for the event day) and an owner. Applied to an event with a date, the template creates the tasks with their due dates.
Events.noTaskTemplateItems: This template has no task yet.
Events.starterRetroplanningLoaded: Starter template loaded: adapt it to the way you work.
Events.taskOffsetDays: Offset in days (negative before the event, positive after)
Events.invalidOffset: Enter a whole number of days, between -1095 and 1095.
Events.taskTemplateApplied: Template applied: the tasks were created.
Events.taskTemplateNeedsDate: Add a date to the event to apply a planning timeline template.
Events.recalculationPendingFirst: First answer the due date recalculation proposal.
Events.recalculationProposal: The event date was moved {direction, select, later {later} other {earlier}} by {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Shift {count, plural, one {the unfinished task} other {the # unfinished tasks}} by the same amount?
Events.programParticipantNotFound: A chosen participant is not a vendor slot of this event.
Events.programVendorParticipants: Participants among the event's vendor slots
Events.programTemplatesIntro: A schedule template is a list of lines (times, title, location, participants). Applied to an event, it adds its lines to the schedule; a participant named like one of the event's vendor slots is linked to that slot.
Events.noProgramTemplateItems: This template has no line yet.
Events.starterProgramLoaded: Starter template loaded: adapt it to the way you work.
Events.programTemplateApplied: Template applied: the lines were added to the schedule.
Events.clientAccessIntro: Invite each member of the couple by e-mail: they create their own account, follow the planning timeline, check their tasks and see the wedding day schedule (without your internal notes). You can remove an access at any time.
Events.noClientAccess: No one from the couple invited yet.
Events.clientLinked: This person already has an account: access to this event is now open.
Events.clientEmailUnavailable: This e-mail is already used by another account.
Events.clientAlreadyInvited: This person already has access to the event.
Events.noActivity: No activity from the couple yet.
Events.trialIntro: Discover the module on a ready-made fictional wedding (vendor slots, planning timeline, wedding day schedule): change its status, book a vendor, check tasks, export the schedule. Your real events are never touched, and everything is deleted when the trial ends (or after 24 hours).
Events.trialEnded: Trial ended: its fictional data has been deleted.
Events.trialBannerBody: This event is fictional: it never shows on the dashboard or in GDPR searches, and it will be deleted when the trial ends or after 24 hours. Things to try:
Events.trialStepVendor: book a vendor and enter its amount;
Events.trialStepTask: check a planning timeline task, then change the date to see the proposed recalculation;
Events.trialStepProgram: add a schedule line and download the PDF (“Fictional document” watermark).
Events.trialEnd: End the trial and delete its data
Events.trialNoInvite: During the trial, no invitation is sent: the couple is only invited on a real event.
